description: Company policy drafter — Draft a plain-language company or workplace policy (topic; optional company, audience, jurisdiction, notes with your rules, effective date) with standard sections (purpose, scope, definitions, policy, procedures, responsibilities, exceptions, enforcement, review) plus markdown. Offline checks: missing standard sections, absolute wording, vague terms, Flesch readability, and an employment-law review flag for sensitive topics (leave, harassment, monitoring, drugs, overtime, privacy, social media). Not legal advice. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_policy
